title: Integral extension, prime transitivity and quotient lifting for a profinite invariant-ring action
statement: Let $G$ be a compact Hausdorff totally disconnected topological group (multiplication and inversion are continuous), acting continuously by ring automorphisms on a discrete commutative ring $B$. Let $A\subseteq B$ be a subring such that $B^G=A$, where $B^G=\{b\in B:\forall g\in G,\ g(b)=b\}$. Then $B$ is integral over $A$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure]. For any prime ideals $Q,Q'\subset B$ with $Q\cap A=Q'\cap A$, there exists $g\in G$ such that $g(Q)=Q'$. For any prime ideal $Q\subset B$ and $P=Q\cap A$, every $A/P$-algebra automorphism of $B/Q$ is induced by an element of $\operatorname{Stab}_G(Q)=\{g\in G:g(Q)=Q\}$, through $\bar b\mapsto\overline{g(b)}$.

mathlib_match.how: One declaration per clause: lines 49-50, 61-64 and 175-179, read with the common hypotheses at 39-44. Use the inclusion A -> B as algebra map. B^G=A is exactly Algebra.IsInvariant A B G for an inclusion; g(ab)=a g(b) supplies SMulCommClass because A is fixed pointwise. CompactSpace, TotallyDisconnectedSpace and IsTopologicalGroup are the stated topological hypotheses, DiscreteTopology and ContinuousSMul are the stated action hypotheses. The transitivity equation Q' = g • Q is the image of ideals under g. The quotient stabilizer map has precisely the formula in the statement (Ideal.Quotient.stabilizerHom_apply, Mathlib/RingTheory/Ideal/Over.lean). No finiteness, domain, maximality or separability assumption is required.
